content:
Omar: Postmortem follow-up: metering undercount + delayed ingestion. We need owners for: credit issuance, ledger backfill, RCA for recurring pattern, and short customer note. Can folks claim items?

Nina: I'll take credit issuance and audit trail. Will prepare CSV and voucher codes. Target Wed 12:00 PT.

Carl: I'll run the ledger backfill and validation. Plan: run in staging canary (50 accounts) then full. ETA canary Tue 02:00 UTC, full Wed 04:00 UTC.

Priya: I'll lead the recurrence RCA with Eng-Infra. Early signal suggests consumer checkpointing drift during redeploys. Will instrument replayer metrics. ETA Thu EOD.

billing-bot: Created ticket INV-459 for credit adjustments (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INV-459)

Carl: Validation snippet I'll use:

```
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens_raw) as raw, SUM(tokens_fixed) as fixed, SUM(tokens_fixed)-SUM(tokens_raw) as delta
FROM billing_snapshots
WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-12'
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING ABS(delta) > 0;
```

Nina: For customer messaging, I'll keep it concise: "We detected and corrected a metering error affecting usage from Mar 10-12. Credits applied to impacted accounts." Will share draft.

Priya: I'll add an alert: metering_consumer_lag > 300s for 5m window and a dashboard panel for replay success rate.

Omar: Ownership summary:
- Credits: Nina (INV-459)
- Ledger backfill: Carl (canary Tue 02:00 UTC)
- RCA + recurrence mitigation: Priya
- Customer note: Nina

Omar: Please update tickets and mark blockers. Reconvene Thu 09:00 PT to close.

Carl: Scheduling canary with infra-bot now.

infra-bot: Canary scheduled Tue 02:00-02:30 UTC. Reminder set 15m prior.

Nina: I'll upload CSV to /finance/credits and ping CS after credits post.

Priya: Starting instrumentation, will post findings in FIN-rca thread.

Omar: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
